_doc: L7 analyze ground truth = our self-consistent reproduction (3_reproduction/L7/pin_N56/pin_record.json, canonical block: paper-x=[11-2] projection, canonical field, N=56 (benchmark re-pin, reviewer 2026-09-03; the stage-3 N=72 record is 3_reproduction/L7/pin_record.json), gamma=50 meV, both poles, spectral weight |v|^2/(E_u - E_l) per occupied-to-empty pair with no explicit omega factor). All five graded fields are dimensionless ratios, so the reproduction's ungraded overall prefactor drops out. The top-two peak ordering (p5.3e20 vs p1.1e21) is a near-tie in our reproduction (+0.55% at N=56, +0.14% at N=72, sign-oscillates with mesh, flips within the L3 +/-5 meV E_F tolerance) and is deliberately NOT graded; no answer field encodes it.
